title: Manuals
description: a mod that locks some utility block behind manuals
body:
Manuals is a simple mod that adds a Vanilla-friendly progression layer to Minecraft. Before you can use certain blocks or trade with certain mobs, you must first read their manuals that can be found throughout the world.

**How it works** Skills are the gated capabilities (e.g. Enchanting, Brewing, Anvils). Each skill needs 3 ranks to unlock. Manuals are the items you read. Each manual grants one rank toward the skills it covers. They look like enchanted books with a glint. Read a manual by right-clicking it. Once you've read enough distinct manuals to meet the rank requirement, the skill unlocks and you can use its blocks/entities normally. Reading a manual for the first time also grants a small XP reward (configurable).

**Manuals and What They Unlock**

**Basic Manuals (Single Skill)**

- Manual of Enchanting - Unlocks Enchanting Table
- Manual of Brewing - Unlocks Brewing Stand
- Manual of Anvils - Unlocks Anvil, Chipped Anvil, Damaged Anvil
- Manual of Smithing - Unlocks Smithing Table
- Manual of Stonecutting - Unlocks Stonecutter
- Manual of Grindstone - Unlocks Grindstone
- Manual of Fletching - Unlocks Fletching Table
- Manual of Looms - Unlocks Loom
- Manual of the Trade - Unlocks Wandering Trader interactions

**Large Manuals (Multiple Skills)**
- Manual of the Arcane - Unlocks Enchanting Table and Brewing Stand
- Manual of Blacksmithing - Unlocks Anvils (all types) and Smithing Table

**Master Manual (Creative Only)**

- Master Manual - Unlocks all skills/blocks/entities

**Manual of the Dumb (Creative Only)** V1.1.0

- Manual of the Dumb - Forgets everything
